title: KATSEYE Cook Buldak Ramen Carbonara Together | Now Serving | Vogue
description:
Sophia, Daniela, Lara, and Yoonchae of KATSEYE get together in the Vogue kitchen to cook up some Buldak Carbonara. Starting off with some virgin piña coladas, watch as KATSEYE argue over who is the worst cook, whisper secrets, sing some Rihanna, and talk about their new song, "Animal," which was co-written by Ed Sheeran.
